scope: DEV50 integrated-state replacement of six historical crash windows
state_path: NORMAL -> (A OR B OR C) -> DEFENSIVE -> recovery evidence -> R1 -> NORMAL

A.name: rapid systemic concurrence
A.rule: Funding stress percentile >=95%, median market drawdown bad-tail percentile >=95%, VVIX percentile >=95%, breadth-positive-20 damage percentile >=95%; 4-of-4 for 5 consecutive sessions
A.selection_basis: lowest nuisance episode count in pre-portfolio strict-concurrence neighborhood while retaining 2020 detection; no portfolio fitness
A.qualification: conservative reconstructed Path-A rule; 2020 declaration expected near 2020-03-09; B/C provide complementary coverage

B.name: slow deterioration
B.rule: negative-day fraction 40-session percentile >=85% AND lagged OFR Funding 20-session change percentile >=85%; 2-of-2 for 3 consecutive sessions
B.selection_basis: surviving heldout-2008 slow-bear LOCO rule; no portfolio fitness

C.name: strict slow-bear concurrence
C.rule: negative-day fraction20, failed-rebound30, negative-day fraction40, lagged OFR Funding change30 each >= rolling historical 90th percentile; 4-of-4 for 3 consecutive sessions
C.selection_basis: surviving strict Group-C/full-history rule; no portfolio fitness

DEFENSIVE.entry: first A OR B OR C declaration while NORMAL
DEFENSIVE.activity: daily competitive allocator subject to Defensive constraints; SAFE residual permitted

R1.name: H2_50 conservative stress normalization
R1.rule: all four Group-C causal percentile ranks <50% for 3 consecutive sessions while DEFENSIVE
R1.basis: among pre-frozen reentry candidates, looser H2_60/70/80 were premature in both 2008 and 2022; H2_50 declared after reference troughs without portfolio fitting
R1.transition: R1 declaration ends DEFENSIVE authority for this test; subsequent dates are NORMAL

note: This is the first integrated-state DEV50 test. It supersedes hand-cut crash-window boundaries only in the new integrated report; the original six-window diagnostic remains preserved.
